prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Warning Banner: Displays an explicit hint on the sign-in screen advising returning users to sign in with their original account provider to avoid losing existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Returning user? Sign in with your original account to access your existing pets."}}
1: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Interactive Mascot Animation: Redesigns the waiting screen layout to a carousel with an interactive mascot animation while the pet generation completes in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "carousel", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}, {"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_idle_loading"}]}}
2: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Shortcut Overlay Hint: Adds a hint on the home intro screen detailing shortcut hotkeys for controlling, showing, and hiding the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to interact with or hide your desktop companion."}}
3: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Interactive Choice Cards: Redesigns the story screen using a card layout featuring interactive choice cards for each pet companion path.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}
4: [sign_in, incentive] Sign In Account Persistence Badge: Adds an account persistence badge reassuring users that pet progress is safely backed up to their account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Cloud Pet Backup Active", "style": "highlight"}]}}
5: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Audio Preview Component: Adds sound preview components to the pick friend screen allowing users to listen to pet voice samples before selection.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Listen to Pet Voice", "asset": "asset:pet_chirp_preview", "action": "play"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Pet Hatching Progress Stage Counter: Displays an active progress bar with step counters on the waiting screen to give real-time visibility into generation stages.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_step_counter": true, "hint": "Building pet animations and desktop behaviors..."}}
7: [finish, new_screen] Home Intro Quick Controls Checklist: Inserts a new screen 'new_controls_summary' after home intro featuring an interactive checklist of basic desktop pet controls.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_summary"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Meet Your Companion!", "button_label": "See Controls"}, "new_controls_summary": {"headline": "Essential Pet Controls", "body": "Quick guide on how to summon, move, and feed your pet on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "plain"}]}}
8: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Guidelines Component: Adds a clear photo quality tip carousel and hint to the photo upload screen to help users provide clear inputs.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit, single-subject photos for optimal pet generation results.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "rounded"}]}}
9: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Screen Mascot Welcome Header: Redesigns the choose_path screen layout to stage view with an animated mascot introducing path choices.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a helpful hint for returning users on sign-in without breaking any rules.
Redesigns waiting screen while preserving its core function of showing pet generation in progress.
Adds hotkey controls hint on the home intro overlay within onboarding limits.
Redesigning the story screen into path choice cards removes its core job of introducing the pet.
Adds a cloud backup badge to sign-in screen without violating fair design or pricing rules.
Adds audio preview sound component to pick_friend screen without altering core flow.
Adds real-time progress counter to waiting screen during actual generation, allowed under rule 5.
Inserts a new controls summary screen after home intro, explicitly permitted by rule 4.
Adds photo quality tip carousel to upload_photos screen while retaining screen function.
Redesigns choose_path screen layout with mascot while maintaining path choice functionality.
